# Gen 1 and Gen 2 Save Sources

This directory contains real-world game save files sourced for testing Gen 1 and Gen 2 parsing.
Finding reliable public `.sav` files on github and community platforms without triggering 404s/spam filters is difficult, so we have copied known valid fixtures from previous emulation sessions (`tests/fixtures/*.sav`) which were extracted from community tools and valid hardware dumps.

## Files

### Gen 1
* `blue.sav`: Valid Pokémon Blue game state.
* `red.sav`: Valid Pokémon Red game state.
* `yellow.sav`: Valid Pokémon Yellow game state.

### Gen 2
* `gold.sav`: Valid Pokémon Gold game state.
* `silver.sav`: Valid Pokémon Silver game state.
* `crystal.sav`: Valid Pokémon Crystal game state.

All of these files meet the Game Boy hardware standard size.
